rules.summary: Every audited path must remain inside the repository and contain no symbolic-link segment.
rules.remediation: Replace linked inputs with reviewed regular files inside the TaskSpace.

rules.summary: Source comments cannot disable policy, tests, tenant, permission, review, or verification gates.
rules.remediation: Remove the bypass. A real exception must be published in the versioned Harness policy.

rules.summary: A passing governance receipt covers the complete Git change; an explicit path subset is diagnostic only.
rules.remediation: Run the audit from the repository root without --path against the reviewed base commit.

rules.summary: Every new business table has id, tenant_id, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time, and del_flag.
rules.remediation: Use the Forge business-table template and its TenantEntity/TableLogic contract.

rules.summary: New tables use InnoDB and utf8mb4.
rules.remediation: Declare ENGINE=InnoDB and DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4.

rules.summary: New business tables and required governance columns declare reviewed types and SQL comments.
rules.remediation: Use BIGINT identifiers/governance flags, DATETIME audit timestamps, and explicit table/column comments.

rules.summary: Logical deletion uses BIGINT del_flag default 0; active-only unique keys include tenant_id and del_flag.
rules.remediation: Use @TableLogic(value="0", delval="id") and a tenant/business-key/del_flag unique key.

rules.summary: Applied Flyway migrations are append-only and destructive DDL is not generated by an ordinary task.
rules.remediation: Create the next migration and use an independently reviewed data-migration runbook for destructive changes.

rules.summary: New Flyway files use the canonical version/name, advance beyond the base, never duplicate a version, and contain no unbounded UPDATE/DELETE.
rules.remediation: Allocate the next reviewed Vx.y.z__lower_snake.sql migration and bound every data change with an explicit predicate.

rules.summary: Seed inserts list columns, are idempotent, use tenant 1, and do not leave Flyway placeholders.
rules.remediation: Add explicit columns and NOT EXISTS/INSERT IGNORE/ON DUPLICATE KEY protection; replace tenant 0 and raw ${...}.

rules.summary: Mapper XML uses explicit columns, active-row filtering, and stable pagination order.
rules.remediation: Replace SELECT *; include del_flag/tenant rules and ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC for page queries.

rules.summary: New table entities extend TenantEntity without redeclaring inherited audit fields.
rules.remediation: Extend TenantEntity and keep only id, business fields, and delFlag in the entity.

rules.summary: A logical-delete entity declares Long delFlag with the primary-key tombstone TableLogic contract.
rules.remediation: Add @TableLogic(value = "0", delval = "id") to Long delFlag.

rules.summary: Pagination uses PageQuery or pageNum/pageSize and database paging; in-memory paging is forbidden.
rules.remediation: Pass Page/IPage to Mapper XML and remove List.subList/stream skip-limit pagination.

rules.summary: The shared PageQuery owner consumes normalized getters, aliases normalize invalid inputs, and boundary tests cannot preserve illegal page values.
rules.remediation: Use getPageNum()/getPageSize() in toPage(), normalize null/zero/negative aliases, and test null, zero, negative, maximum, and over-maximum inputs.

rules.summary: Business query SQL belongs to Mapper XML, not Service wrappers or annotation SQL.
rules.remediation: Move query/list/page conditions and SQL into the module Mapper XML.

rules.summary: Generated CRUD uses /getById, /add, /edit and /remove/{id} POST-safe routes.
rules.remediation: Use Forge's generated CRUD controller contract; do not introduce PUT/DELETE variants.

rules.summary: Controllers return RespInfo, log mutating operations, and delegate business logic.
rules.remediation: Move persistence/business branching to Service and add OperationLog/RespInfo.

rules.summary: Domain helpers live in module support; reusable technical utilities live in the owning starter util package and have tests.
rules.remediation: Choose the capability owner, move the class to support or starter util, and add a matching unit test.

rules.summary: Backend code does not swallow exceptions, print to stdout, expose secrets in logs, or hardcode credentials.
rules.remediation: Use typed business exceptions, structured masked logging, and mounted/configured secrets.

rules.summary: Ordinary request DTOs cannot accept tenantId and tenant-scoped entities/queries must use the platform tenant context.
rules.remediation: Remove tenantId from the client contract and derive it from the authenticated TenantContext.

rules.summary: Missing tenant context fails closed and never falls back to a constant tenant ID.
rules.remediation: Throw a stable unauthorized/tenant-context business error, or propagate an explicitly authorized tenant scope; add missing-tenant and cross-tenant negative tests.

rules.summary: Persistence mutations cannot discard boolean or affected-row outcomes and then report success.
rules.remediation: Check IService boolean results and BaseMapper affected-row counts, map false or an unexpected row count to a stable not-found, stale-write, or concurrent-change error, and add zero-row tests.

rules.summary: Every new non-public endpoint has SaCheckPermission enforcement or an exact method+path API resource in the same change.
rules.remediation: Add a backend permission annotation or a type-4 API resource; public endpoints require the explicit public annotation.

rules.summary: Button and API resources are attached to their owning menu instead of becoming root-level orphan nodes.
rules.remediation: Resolve the menu resource ID and use it as parent_id for every resource_type 3/4 seed; parent_id 0 is reserved for true root menus.

rules.summary: Changed button/API resources and Controller endpoints agree on permission, HTTP method, URL, and owning menu.
rules.remediation: Use one literal permission contract across the button, type-4 API resource, and SaCheckPermission endpoint; keep button/API parents identical.

rules.summary: Changed role-resource grants select only active, non-deleted roles.
rules.remediation: Join or guard sys_role with role_status = 1 and del_flag = 0 before inserting sys_role_resource rows.

rules.summary: New business CRUD pages and changed table/form/pagination structures reuse AiCrudPage. Unchanged structures in existing pages remain recorded as legacy findings against the protected review base.
rules.remediation: Use AiCrudPage for new or changed CRUD structures; retain unrelated historical findings without renewing whole-file exceptions.

rules.summary: Dictionary-backed options and labels use useDict, DictSelect, and DictTag rather than page-local maps.
rules.remediation: Create/reuse a dict_type and bind the canonical dictionary components through computed schemas.

rules.summary: Frontend generated CRUD paths and methods match the POST-safe backend and use :id placeholders.
rules.remediation: Use post@.../getById, add, edit, remove/:id; never {id}, put@, or delete@.

rules.summary: Every changed menu resource binds a literal component to a real Forge Admin view in the same worktree.
rules.remediation: Create/reuse forge-admin-ui/src/views/<component>.vue (or its canonical index/module form) and seed that exact repository-relative component key.

rules.summary: Snowflake Long IDs stay strings and protected files/images use AuthImage or the authenticated file adapter.
rules.remediation: Keep Snowflake IDs as quoted strings from fixtures through API calls, remove Number(id) coercion, and route protected file rendering through AuthImage.

rules.summary: Frontend API modules use the project request adapter, not direct axios/fetch clients.
rules.remediation: Use the canonical request utility so auth, encryption, errors, and tracing remain consistent.

rules.summary: New admin pages and changed lines/components use Naive UI and Forge design tokens. Unchanged legacy colors/components remain recorded against the protected review base.
rules.remediation: Use semantic UnoCSS classes/CSS variables and Naive UI for new or changed code; keep unrelated historical findings visible without treating them as remediated.

rules.summary: Production frontend code cannot dynamically load latest/CDN scripts or use Math.random for nonce, trace, or idempotency identifiers.
rules.remediation: Pin build-time dependencies and use crypto.randomUUID/getRandomValues for security-relevant identifiers.

rules.summary: New Forge Admin business UI uses semantic tokens and the canonical Naive UI owner.
rules.remediation: Replace raw colors and Element Plus controls with Forge tokens and canonical components.

rules.summary: New business views call src/api adapters; only API adapters depend on the canonical request owner.
rules.remediation: Move transport calls into a src/api adapter, import the canonical request owner there, and remove direct request, axios, or fetch access from the business view.

rules.summary: New business UI does not use browser alert, confirm, or prompt dialogs.
rules.remediation: Use the canonical Forge feedback and dangerous-confirmation owner.

rules.summary: Clickable div and span elements expose focus and keyboard activation semantics.
rules.remediation: Prefer a native button or add role=button, tabindex=0, and Enter/Space activation.

rules.summary: Obvious mutation buttons use the canonical v-hasPermi directive.
rules.remediation: Bind the button to its exact permission through v-hasPermi and retain backend enforcement.

rules.summary: Obvious destructive actions use the canonical dangerous-confirmation owner.
rules.remediation: Wrap destructive mutations with NPopconfirm or the reviewed danger-confirm service.

rules.summary: Protected images use AuthImage or the authenticated file adapter.
rules.remediation: Replace raw protected image bindings with AuthImage or an authenticated file URL.

rules.summary: Ordinary business CRUD pages use AiCrudPage rather than page-local pagination.
rules.remediation: Move ordinary CRUD tables, actions, forms, and paging to AiCrudPage.

rules.summary: Ordinary new business forms use AiForm.
rules.remediation: Represent the form through AiForm schema and canonical validation behavior.

rules.summary: New business option labels use DictSelect, DictTag, and useDict rather than page-local maps.
rules.remediation: Register or reuse a dictionary and bind the canonical dictionary components.

rules.summary: New business UI does not access authentication token browser storage directly.
rules.remediation: Use getToken, setToken, and removeToken through the canonical auth owner.

rules.summary: New business uploads use the canonical authenticated upload owner.
rules.remediation: Use the shared upload component or authenticated custom-request adapter instead of a direct action URL.

rules.summary: Custom business UI identifies loading, empty, error, and busy state ownership.
rules.remediation: Use AiCrudPage or retain browser evidence for each explicit async state.

rules.summary: A new business API adapter has at least one real UI consumer.
rules.remediation: Add or identify the importing business view and retain the consumer graph evidence.

rules.summary: A new shared business component has at least two real consumers.
rules.remediation: Keep one-off UI local or identify two importing consumers before establishing a shared owner.

rules.summary: Approval work uses Flowable bindings, business_key/process_instance_id, callbacks, and BPMN; a status column alone is not a workflow.
rules.remediation: Use forge-business-flow-development and provide the full Flowable integration artifacts.

rules.summary: Menu, button, API resource, backend enforcement, tenant, and data-scope behavior form one reviewed contract.
rules.remediation: Add positive and anonymous/no-permission/cross-tenant/direct-API negative cases.

rules.summary: A new global component or utility requires a reuse search, canonical owner decision, API contract, documentation, and two consumers.
rules.remediation: Reuse the existing owner or attach the independent owner-review evidence.

rules.summary: Table category, permanent versus active uniqueness, index order, migration lock risk, retention, and rollback are independently reviewed.
rules.remediation: Record the table classification and query evidence; a model cannot self-approve an exception.

rules.summary: Mutation boundaries explicitly cover transactions, duplicate requests, concurrency, stable error codes, HTTP status, safe messages, and request IDs.
rules.remediation: Bind the selected transaction/idempotency/lock strategy and negative API tests to the same change.

rules.summary: Changed user flows verify responsive layout, keyboard/focus behavior, loading, empty, error, permission, and retry states in a real browser.
rules.remediation: Run the project browser acceptance profile and retain screenshots/network/console evidence.

rules.summary: New failure and business-critical paths define masked structured logs, request/trace propagation, metrics, alerts, and a runbook owner.
rules.remediation: Add directly exercised observability assertions; console output and prose are not telemetry evidence.

rules.summary: New runtime dependencies, remote scripts, container bases, and dynamic installers are immutable and version pinned.
rules.remediation: Replace latest/wildcard/remote execution and mutable image tags with reviewed versions and immutable digests.

rules.summary: New Service, Controller, support/helper, utility, and canonical component code ships with matching automated tests.
rules.remediation: Add a focused regression/contract test in the owning module or component test directory.

rules.summary: Bug fixes and new behavior retain independent RED and GREEN receipts bound to the same diff lineage.
rules.remediation: Run the controlled Evidence Runner; model prose is not a test receipt.

rules.summary: Changed tests and verification configuration cannot disable, skip, or silently exclude the required checks.
rules.remediation: Remove skip/disabled flags and run the policy-selected verification command through the Evidence Runner.

rules.summary: Reflection contract tests inspect annotations on their real Java element and cannot use selectors that are guaranteed to return null.
rules.remediation: For parameter annotations, select Method.getParameters()[n] and call Parameter.getAnnotation(), or inspect getParameterAnnotations().

rules.summary: Changed Java tests import only frameworks supplied by the owning Maven module or its explicitly declared local parent chain.
rules.remediation: Use an already admitted test module that depends on the production owner, or add the reviewed test dependency to the owning module before claiming the test compiles.

rules.summary: Changed build and verification configuration cannot make tests opt-out by default or exclude the required suites.
rules.remediation: Enable tests in the reviewed build profile and make any scoped exclusion explicit in the external policy.

rules.summary: Skills cannot contain unrelated privileged commands, dynamic installers, embedded credentials, or missing tool references.
rules.remediation: Remove the instruction, pin the capability in the image, and register it in the capability catalog.
